nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
UniswapExchange.ensure(address,address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate that bypasses sell restrictions for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale callers
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable; allowance + balance bookkeeping with unchecked subtraction and _onSaleNum increment
UniswapExchange.approve(address,uint) payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][spender]
UniswapExchange.condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale and per-address sale count limits
UniswapExchange.delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker supplied address
UniswapExchange.init(uint,uint,uint); owner-only configuration of sale limits and scaling by decimals
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-only loop crediting recipients and emitting duplicated Transfer events
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address); owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes deterministic Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash
UniswapExchange constructor(string,string,uint) payable; mints totalSupply to owner and grants infinite allowance to UNI router
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) private; performs low-level external call to a token and decodes optional return data
Address.isContract(address) internal view; extcodehash based check that target code exists
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint) internal; SafeMath guarded balance movement with zero-address checks
ERC20._mint(address,uint) internal; increases _totalSupply and recipient balance
ERC20._burn(address,uint) internal; decreases balance and _totalSupply
ERC20._approve(address,address,uint) internal; writes the _allowances mapping with zero-address checks
Context._msgSender() internal view; returns msg.sender as address payable
mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum; per-address number of completed sales, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition
mapping(address=>bool) canSale; whitelist that bypasses the sale restriction gate in ensure
uint256 _minSale; minimum sale amount enforced by condition, set in init
uint256 _maxSale; maximum sale amount enforced by condition, set in init
uint256 _saleNum; allowed number of sales per address, written in init and read in condition
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address that bypasses ensure restrictions
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token ledger mutated in transferFrom, batchSend and constructor
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals mutated in approve and transferFrom
address private owner; privileged account checked in delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor
uint public constant decimals = 18; scaling factor used by init
string public name; human readable token name set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; Uniswap router address used inside the ensure whitelist check
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for authorization, transfer source and allowance ownership
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); arbitrary external code executed in this contract context by the owner

total = _value * _tos.length; unchecked multiplication without SafeMath in batchSend
